entries.zh: 从旁边过来；打边（靠在一旁）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to come by/from the side; to come alongside (uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏第3字'人'半没墨渍且闽南语三音节皆 T99 污损，仅据可辨之'打邊'与西语词头 Venir por el lado 推义。

entries.zh: 空手而来；分文不带地来（sin blanca：不名一文）；白白来（徒然而来）
entries.en: to come without a coin / empty-handed (sin blanca); to come for nothing

entries.zh: 空无一物而来；什么都没带地来
entries.en: to come with nothing; to come empty-handed

entries.zh: 同船而来；与…同乘一条船（同船之人）
entries.en: to come in the same boat; to arrive together in one boatload (barcada)

entries.zh: 最先来；头一个来；领头先到
entries.en: to come first; to be the first to arrive

entries.zh: 先来；先于他人而来；早先到
entries.en: to come before (others); to come earlier

entries.zh: 专程远道而来；特地为某事而来（迢递：远路）
entries.en: to come on purpose / expressly (from afar); to travel a long way for something

entries.zh: 迢迢远道而来；专程跋涉前来
entries.en: to come from afar; to make a long journey thither

entries.zh: 远道前来拜见致敬；呈递'服从状'、投帖行晋见礼（dar la obediencia）
entries.en: to come (from afar) to present one's obedience; to pay formal homage / make a courtesy visit

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑为'郊〻来'（自郊外前来）或'节节而来'，难以定夺
entries.en: uncertain; possibly 'to come from the outskirts' or 'to come step by step' — text corrupt
entries.notes: 西语词头讹作 de ross en vno 且标 [疑]，汉字 邵/郊 两可，音写 chat-chat 与任一候选义皆无法确证。

entries.zh: 径直而来；直接前来（汉字栏 序/存 存疑，未能确证）
entries.en: to come straight / directly (venir derecho)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑指成伙（cuadrilla）结伴而来，词头讹误难辨
entries.en: uncertain; possibly 'to come as a group / cuadrilla' — headword corrupt
entries.notes: 西语词头 Venir vna quadriglla y ora 文理不通且标 [疑]，仅能以 cuadrilla（一小伙人）姑作推断。

entries.zh: 其后愈来愈多的人来；以后还有人陆续来
entries.en: many more to come afterwards; to keep coming in increasing numbers

entries.zh: 突然不期而来；慌慌张张赶到
entries.en: to come suddenly / unexpectedly (de improviso); to arrive in haste

entries.zh: 慌慌张张而来；惊慌失措地赶到
entries.en: to come in a panic / wildly hurried

entries.zh: 因祸得福；祸中生福（坏事引出好结果）
entries.en: good to come out of evil; blessing in disguise, gain through misfortune
entries.notes: 主行四栏完整互证（因祸得福 = venir el bien por el mal），仅第二行涂改残损，故不降为 low。

entries.zh: 客馆；客栈；投宿落脚
entries.en: inn, lodging-house (venta); to lodge, take up one's lodging (aposentarse)

entries.zh: 驿馆；驿站（官设驿舍）
entries.en: official post station / relay inn (for mandarins)

entries.zh: 食驿；在驿站用膳（享用驿站饭食接待）
entries.en: to eat at / be provisioned by the post station

entries.zh: 公驿；官驿（为官员设置的公办驿馆）
entries.en: public / official post station; mandarins' inn

entries.zh: 五里亭（每隔一段路程设于路旁的歇脚亭，犹'每五里一亭'）
entries.en: wayside rest pavilion ('five-li pavilion'); a venta/stage set at fixed intervals (every five leagues)
